description:
List recently modified files, newest first, plus session_edits (files you wrote in this session).
Use when: you start or resume a task, or finished a build, format or git step and want to see what changed. Feed the top paths into project_read_batch.
Avoid when: you need the full tree (project_list_files) or a content search (project_search).
Output: entries[] {relative_path, size_bytes, modified_ago_seconds}, session_edits, truncated.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.

name: project_recent_files
title: Recent files
